items.stem: An indoor robot's wheel odometry says it has travelled straight, but it has actually drifted sideways. Which capability most directly corrects this?

options.text: Localisation that fuses external sensing (e.g. LiDAR) with odometry to correct accumulated drift
options.rationale: Correct: odometry drifts over time; fusing it with external references corrects the pose estimate.

options.text: Increasing motor torque to drive straighter
options.rationale: Torque does not fix an estimation error about where the robot is.

options.text: Switching off all sensors to reduce noise
options.rationale: Removing sensing removes the information needed to correct drift.
A bigger map does not by itself correct odometry drift.

items.explanation: Correct: odometry drifts over time; fusing it with external references corrects the pose estimate.

items.stem: Which TWO responsibilities belong to an autonomous mobile robot's navigation stack? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Planning a path from the robot's pose to a goal
options.rationale: Correct: path planning is a core navigation responsibility.

options.text: Avoiding obstacles detected along the way
options.rationale: Correct: local avoidance/replanning handles obstacles during motion.

options.text: Signing the robot's firmware for security
options.rationale: Firmware signing is a security task, not part of navigation.

options.text: Billing the customer for the delivery
options.rationale: Billing is a business function unrelated to navigation.

items.explanation: Correct: path planning is a core navigation responsibility.

items.stem: What is SLAM, in one sentence?

options.text: Building a map of an unknown environment while simultaneously tracking the robot's position within it
options.rationale: Correct: SLAM jointly estimates the map and the robot's pose.

options.text: Pre-loading a perfect map so no sensing is needed
options.rationale: SLAM is used precisely when no prior map exists.

options.text: A method to make motors run faster
options.rationale: SLAM concerns mapping and localisation, not motor speed.

options.text: A way to delete obstacles from the real world
options.rationale: SLAM perceives obstacles; it cannot remove physical objects.

items.explanation: Correct: SLAM jointly estimates the map and the robot's pose.
